messages:
sara_p: Quick sync — Q2 packaging decision needed. Big enterprise pilot wants a hybrid: per-seat base + token-slab for high-volume features, plus a 'priority-lane' addon for real-time inference. We need to decide scope, limits, and launch criteria by EOD tomorrow.

mike_sales: +1. Customer will only sign if priority-lane available and a hard cap on overage rates. They're pushing for 99.9% p99 SLA.

jordan_eng: 99.9% p99 for priority-lane across 1536-token context is doable with Dedicated, but on Hosted we'd need reserved capacity + routing. Adds infra cost.

anna_revops: For billing the hybrid, we need clear meter events: seat_count, slab_units_consumed, priority_lane_minutes. Any change requires 2-week lead time for billing pipeline.

olivia_finance: We ran a quick sim — hybrid reduces sticker shock but increases forecasting variance. If we include burst credits, forecast error jumps ~8%. Need guardrails (softcap + hard overage).

sara_p: Proposed guardrails: base seats cover up to X tokens/day per seat (we'll fill X after data pull). Slab tiers: 0-1M, 1M-10M, >10M with per-token step-down. Priority-lane as add-on with per-minute reservation + overage rate 2x normal. Thoughts?

mike_sales: Customers want a migration path from current slab-only. Recommend an incentive: first 3 months of priority-lane at 50% for pilot. Also need contract clause: bailout if latency > target for 2 consecutive weeks.

jordan_eng: Technical constraints: priority-lane requires dedicated pool or guaranteed preemption protection. We can implement pre-warm and eviction policies but will need an autoscale tweak and a rollout canary. Impact: ~3 sprints.

anna_revops: Launch criteria checklist draft: 1) billing events instrumented, 2) console billing UI, 3) docs + pricing page, 4) SLA terms and playbook, 5) pilot contract template. All must be green to ship.

olivia_finance: Add: internal unit economics signoff (target gross margin per tier) and forecasting model updated.

sara_p: Decision proposal: (A) Gate priority-lane behind Dedicated-only for GA, (B) ship hybrid pricing for Hosted (slab+seats) w/ softcap alerts, (C) pilot priority-lane as invite-only with 3-month promo. Approve?

mike_sales: Approve for go-to-pilot. Need legal to review bailout clause but I'm good.

jordan_eng: Ok for pilot but call out infra timeline: engineering ETA 6 weeks to support safe canary + observability hooks.

anna_revops: I'll block billing changes for the next sprint and sync with finance.

olivia_finance: I'll run updated P&L by tomorrow morning.

sara_p: Great — owners: jordan -> infra work (6w), anna -> billing + pricing page, olivia -> unit economics + forecasting, mike -> pilot customer contracts. I'll assemble launch checklist and send a PRD.

devops-bot: New file uploaded: https://redwood.example.com/sheets/pricing-hybrid-simulations (permissions: product,finance).

mike_sales: Thanks — will add pilot customer names & negotiation notes to that sheet.

sara_p: Final note: if legal blocks the bailout clause, we fallback to an SLA credit model (partial credits not termination). Will update after legal review.

anna_revops: Will schedule a 30-min working session tomorrow 9:30am to finalize meter schema. 

sara_p: Perfect. Meeting invite sent. :thumbsup:
